romeo-y-julieta-dr--1875.description: The Dominican mainstay of the Romeo y Julieta range from Altadis U.S.A., named for the year the company was founded in Cuba. A dark, oily, shade-grown Indonesian TBN wrapper covers a Dominican binder and long filler; the smoke is smooth and medium in body, with cedar, hazelnut, leather and earth, a sweet-spiced finish and a white ash.

sources.title: Altadis U.S.A. – Romeo y Julieta 1875
Casa de Montecristo – Romeo y Julieta 1875 Exhibición No. 3

romeo-y-julieta-dr--reserva-real.description: A Dominican Romeo y Julieta that wraps a Nicaraguan binder and a Dominican and Nicaraguan long filler, weighted toward Nicaraguan ligero, in an Ecuador-grown Connecticut Shade leaf. Woody and quietly spiced, it burns slow and even and closes warm and creamy, a medium smoke that fits most hours of the day.

sources.title: Casa de Montecristo – Romeo y Julieta Reserva Real
Altadis U.S.A. – Romeo y Julieta lines

romeo-y-julieta-dr--reserve.description: Made at Flor de Copán in Honduras, the Reserve wraps a deep-brown, silky Nicaraguan leaf around a Nicaraguan binder and a mix of Nicaraguan and Honduran long filler. It is a more seasoned, medium-to-full reading of the house style, with earthy notes, a gentle peppery spice and an aromatic, satisfying finish.

sources.title: Casa de Montecristo – Romeo y Julieta Reserve
Altadis U.S.A. – Romeo y Julieta lines

romeo-y-julieta-dr--romeo-by-romeo-y-jul.description: Introduced in 2012 and made at Tabacalera de García, ROMEO by Romeo y Julieta was a deliberate step away from the brand's softer profile, with an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper chosen for its dark color over a Dominican Piloto binder and Piloto and Olor filler. Natural tobacco, cedar, nuts and cinnamon lead, with spice building toward the end.

thirds.notes: Natural tobacco in front, cedar spice behind, balanced by cinnamon and nut notes.
Nuts come forward with the tobacco as the cinnamon fades and cedar stays in the back.
Spice turns peppery and joins the nuts up front, growing hot toward the nub without harshness.

sources.title: Altadis U.S.A. – ROMEO by Romeo y Julieta
Cigar Coop – Romeo by Romeo y Julieta pre-review

romeo-y-julieta-dr--150th-anniversary.description: A commemorative release for the brand's 150 years, handmade at Tabacalera de García in the Dominican Republic. Its Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper was aged and fermented by A.J. Fernández, the San Andrés binder comes from the Turrent family, and the filler joins Peruvian, Jamastran Valley and Jose Mendez Dominican leaf; cedar and spice deepen into chocolate, coffee and an earthy sweetness.

sources.title: Altadis U.S.A. – Romeo y Julieta 150th Anniversary
Casa de Montecristo – Romeo y Julieta lines

romeo-y-julieta-dr--1875-nicaragua.description: A Nicaraguan puro version of the 1875, made from aged tobacco grown by the Plasencia family and offered as a modern reading of the classic Romeo y Julieta. It is full in strength and robust, with hazelnut, earth and a natural tobacco sweetness, and comes in sizes from Bully to Magnum.

sources.title: Casa de Montecristo – Romeo y Julieta 1875 Nicaragua
Altadis U.S.A. – Romeo y Julieta lines

romeo-y-julieta-dr--1875-connecticut-nic.description: Blended by Altadis U.S.A. master blender Rafael Nodal and rolled at Plasencia in Estelí, this Nicaraguan puro pairs a Nicaraguan-grown, shade Connecticut-seed wrapper with vintage binder and filler from the Plasencia farms. It starts mild-medium and settles at a gentle medium, with cream, cedar and citrus giving way to wood and light pepper.

thirds.notes: Cream, citrus and cedar open evenly, then cedar and cream lead as earth and black pepper appear.
Cream recedes and wood takes over, with pepper rising but staying in the background.
Cream returns beside the wood, with pepper, citrus and earth still present to a cool finish.

sources.title: Altadis U.S.A. – Romeo y Julieta 1875 Connecticut Nicaragua
Casa de Montecristo – Romeo y Julieta lines
Cigar Coop – Romeo y Julieta 1875 Connecticut Nicaragua Toro review

romeo-y-julieta-dr--reserva-real-nicarag.description: Blended by Rafael Nodal and A.J. Fernández from tobacco grown on Fernández's farms, this Nicaraguan puro is made at Tabacalera A.J. Fernández in Estelí and gives the Reserva Real a Nicaraguan voice. Bolder than most of the brand, it moves from natural tobacco and orange-peel fruit toward earth, a caramel-like sweetness and baker's spice.

thirds.notes: Natural tobacco and orange-peel fruit lead over earth, pepper and baker's spice, building as it goes.
A caramel sweetness forms on the tobacco while earth, pepper and spice all grow, earth moving forward.
Earth edges past the tobacco, pepper and baker's spice sharpen and a little fruit sweetness lingers.

sources.title: Altadis U.S.A. – Romeo y Julieta Reserva Real Nicaragua
Cigar Coop – Romeo y Julieta Reserva Real Nicaragua Toro review

romeo-y-julieta-dr--reserva-real-nicarag.description: A barber-pole extension of the Reserva Real Nicaragua, made at the A.J. Fernández factory with two Nicaraguan wrappers twisted over Nicaraguan binder and filler, and blended by Rafael Nodal and A.J. Fernández. Meant as the evening counterpart to the original, it shows coffee and earth with hay, pepper and a light fruit sweetness.

thirds.notes: Coffee leads over earth, hay, pepper and a touch of fruit, with wood on the retrohale.
Earth and hay strengthen, earth reaching the front beside the coffee as pepper builds.
Earth takes over from the coffee while hints of fruit keep some sweetness to the end.

sources.title: Altadis U.S.A. – Romeo y Julieta Reserva Real Nicaragua Midnight Twist
Cigar Coop – Reserva Real Nicaragua Midnight Twist Twisted Toro review

romeo-y-julieta-dr--reserva-real-nicarag.description: The Oscuro member of the Reserva Real family, a Nicaraguan puro under an extra-fermented Oscuro wrapper, blended by Rafael Nodal and A.J. Fernández from Fernández-grown tobacco. It brings espresso and dark chocolate over earth and pepper, with a creamy texture, a molasses-like sweetness on the finish and pepper that builds steadily as it burns.

thirds.notes: Coffee leads with dark chocolate, cream and mixed pepper, earth moving forward and pepper on the retrohale.
Coffee stays in charge as the cream fades and the pepper slowly gains strength.
Pepper joins coffee at the front, with dark chocolate and earth behind and a long finish.

Cigar Coop – Reserva Real Nicaragua Profundo Toro review
Leaf Enthusiast – Romeo y Julieta Reserva Real Profundo review

romeo-y-julieta-dr--envy.description: A limited Romeo y Julieta from Altadis U.S.A., first shipped in December 2022: a Nicaraguan puro rolled at Plasencia S.A. in Estelí and offered in one 6 x 55 toro named Amulet, in green eleven-count boxes. Altadis credits the aging of its tobaccos for an aromatic, generous character at a medium strength.

sources.title: Cigar Coop – Altadis USA to release Romeo y Julieta Envy
Casa de Montecristo – Romeo y Julieta lines

romeo-y-julieta-dr--vintage.description: A Dominican Romeo y Julieta with a blonde Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper, a Mexican binder and a smooth blend of Dominican long filler. Smooth to medium in body, it comes in numbered sizes from Vintage I to Vintage VII, including a triangular Vintage VI, and is positioned as a cigar for special occasions.
